16.en: In my long years, I see that the Imperial Creed has been riddled with bullet holes. Countless ages and crusades have punctured its edifice, chapters torn like limbs severed; we brothers are its dutiful chirurgeons.

22.en: Brother @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Hogarth Drevet} is a devoted member of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.HURMpEU0Nnc93Ocv]{Adeptus Ministorum} living in @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy#hive-skarthius]{Hive Skarthius}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis}. He is an amiable attendant of a well-tended, modest, and largely forgotten shrine located in the mid-levels of the hive and has worked there for as long as anyone can remember. His current rank and station are often misleading; Drevet has a protracted and war-torn past and, despite appearances, carries considerable influence. He has the ear of many high-ranking officials in Persepolis and is a front-line survivor of many battlefields.

26.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Drevet} has been gifted extensive augments and rejuvenat treatments to extend his life; he is currently around one hundred and fifty years old. He crusaded with the Frateris Militia in his early years alongside the Black Templars in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.y6qA7KARTXADwzeV]{Cytheris Subsector}. He charged headfirst into the fray side-by-side with the angels of the Emperor against heretics who strayed far from the Imperial Creed. One fateful day, he was struck down in single combat against a traitor guardsman, suffering wounds that he spent the next decade recovering from. He was told by the chirurgeon who revived him that an unnamed Space Marine personally carried him from the frontlines to the reserves to ensure he survived.

30.en: His shrine, the Cenotaph of Anamnesis, is more of a library than a traditional place of worship, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Drevet} is as much a fixture as the shrine’s collection of historical tomes — he became a scholar during his recovery period, filling his mind with all aspects of the Imperial Creed and tasked with complex research tasks. High-ranking nobles and servants of the Adeptus Terra visit the shrine regularly to converse with Drevet and hear his long-lived words of wisdom or hear a story from his time on the battlefield.

34.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Drevet} has refused promotion many times; superiors within the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.5Bx7K8k9VgjOZmA4]{Ministorum} see him as the perfect example of a war hero, but Drevet is not a man who turns away from an incomplete duty. His current commitment keeps him bound to the library. He is reconciling the Imperial Creed against the tenets and potential revisions uttered by the now-returned Lord Commander and Imperial Regent @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.VVyxPjdULmCks7NP]{Roboute Guilliman} and how it pertains to the turbulent histories of the Macharian Sector.

38.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Hogarth} is conflicted by this work and challenged by it — what his contacts in Terra provide him often fails to align with delicate aspects of the Creed. He knows that failing to complete his work here could result in civil war across the sector, so he works in secret despite the prying eyes of his superiors and to maintain outward appearances.

42.en: He is also armed with a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.tjUKnuDKTCCon28r]{Chainsword}, which he often fiddles the trigger of when nervous, and even carries about his library with him at all times. Regardless of his former injuries, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Drevet} can still hold himself in a fight, and sometimes, he yearns to return to the battlefield.

54.en: The local @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum} lacks sympathy for @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Hogarth's} cause and refuses him entry to certain records and datavaults in the hive to further his research. Hogarth would have greater trust in the characters if they could use their influence to get him access, above or below board.

62.en: Brother @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Drevet} recently attended a service in the depths of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy#hive-skarthius]{Hive Skarthius} in a ruined cathedrum. The preacher alluded to the existence of divine beings other than the God-Emperor. Drevet believes the preacher is a heretic and requests the characters find out who else is associated with them before their vile doctrine spreads further through the hive.

78.en: Brother @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Drevet} may be persuaded to grant the characters access to some of his library if they need it to investigate local cults further. His wizened advice, he gives freely.

86.en: He maintains secure, hidden places in the lower levels of the hive where he stores volatile texts and conducts sacred rites. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5fAQrj0KDjAXkHRY]{Drevet} can provide access to trusted characters if they need to rest, recover, or hide from heretics.
